$comment: At headingLevel 1 the stored h3 would render as h2, which rich-text-body.json's content elements (p, h3 to h6, lists, blockquote) do not allow; that state waits on the contract (a recorded gap), so this case sits at level 2.
summary: Body only, no eyebrow or heading, so the wrapper is a div. Not first on the page (headingLevel 2): the stored h3 and h4 render as h3 and h4 (base + 1 and base + 2).
